entry.title: UBCIT eSAM Servers Maintenance October 22, 2026, 20:00-23:00 PT
entry.content:

Oct 8, 08:14 PDT
Scheduled - UBCIT will be performing maintenance on the eSAM component and vault servers on October 22, 2026, 20:00-23:00 PT. This change will affect both UBC campuses.

Users will intermittently not be able to login to any servers managed by eSAM, nor retrieve any credentials via the eSAM Web UI throughout the maintanance window.

entry.title: Sockeye Maintenance October 20, 2026 09:00 - 18:00 PT
entry.content:
THIS IS A SCHEDULED EVENT Oct 20, 09:00 - 18:00 PDT

Oct 8, 12:18 PDT
Scheduled - UBC ARC Sockeye will be unavailable on Tuesday, October 20 from 09:00 until 18:00 PT for scheduled maintenance.

User Impact:

1. During this time, you will be unable to log in or transfer data to/from Sockeye, OnDemand, and Chinook.

2. All jobs will be queued. The scheduler will not start any job if its requested walltime overlaps with the
maintenance window, even if resources are available. Only jobs expected to finish before downtime
begins will be scheduled, if resources allow.

3. In rare cases, running jobs may need to be resubmitted. Please checkpoint or complete your jobs before
the maintenance window to avoid lost progress, and check your job queue afterward.

entry.title: BC Time Zone Change Planning
entry.content:
Oct 9, 14:14 PDT
Investigating - British Columbia has adopted permanent year-round daylight saving time (Pacific Time), with the change scheduled to take effect on November 1. We recognize that some community members may have questions about the impact on calendars, devices, and scheduled meetings.

UBC IT is actively working with Microsoft and Apple to coordinate the required time zone updates for computers, mobile devices, and calendaring services. We anticipate updates from our vendors will begin rolling out next week.

UBC IT plans to provide detailed guidance by October 16 outlining what to expect and any actions that may be required.
Thank you for your patience as we work to ensure a smooth transition.
